rules.name: The Court of the Nazombu Theme Posse
rules.description:
In a HEX/OUTLAWS Force, instead of a Faction Posse, Marie Laveau may take this
Theme Posse.
If all six slots are filled with at least one unit in the Posse, then all units in the Posse
gain the Trailfinder rule. Marie Laveau is the only unit with the BOSS Trait permitted
in this Posse.

rules.name: Tainted Biology Theme Posse
rules.description:
In an OUTLAWS/ENLIGHTENED/HEX Force, instead of a Faction Posse, Viktor Beitel
may take this Theme Posse.
Units in this Posse may re-roll Taint checks. Viktor Beitel is the only unit with the BOSS
Trait permitted in this Posse.

rules.name: The Dark Nation Theme Posse
rules.description:
In a HEX Force, instead of a Faction Posse, Wicasasni may take this Theme Posse.
If all six slots are filled with at least one unit in the Posse, then all units in the Posse
gain the Shrouded Common rule. Wicasasni is the only unit with the BOSS Trait
permitted in this Posse.

rules.name: The King in Yellow Theme Posse
rules.description:
In a HEX Force, instead of a Faction Posse, Carcosa Rex may take this Theme Posse.
If all six slots are filled with at least one unit in the Posse, then all units in the Posse gain
the Elite rule. Carcosa Rex is the only unit with the BOSS Trait permitted in this Posse.

rules.name: Absolute Power Theme Posse
rules.description:
In a HEX Force, instead of a Faction Posse, The Third Man may take this Theme Posse.
While a unit in this Posse is within 8” of a Hexalith it benefits from the Shrouded
special rule. This Posse may not include units with the CARCOSA, DARK NATION or
NAZOMBU Traits.

rules.name: Hex Faction Posse
rules.description: Any unit with the HEX and BOSS Traits may take this Faction Posse.  You may not have any other Boss units in this Posse and a Boss cannot take two Posses.

rules.name: Mutagenesis
rules.description: This ability costs a Fortune Chip and may be used by this unit once per turn when a MUTATION Face, Hands, or Support unit is destroyed within 6" of this unit.  Immediately, before Taint Checks are made, d5 of the MUTATION models from the destroyed unit are returned to the Play Area within 3" of this unit.  Any model that cannot be placed does not return and is removed from play.  The returned MUTATION unit counts as having Activated for the turn and has the Reanimated rule. Mutagenesis cannot be used against units that are removed from play due to Yeller Checks.

rules.name: Capacity (2)
rules.description: This unit may transport up to two small based models. Units transported in this manner gain the Hunkered condition.  Friendly units can be deployed already mounted in this unit.  Both units are deployed to the battlefield as a single deployment and the transported unit are considered to be mounted.  You cannot put a unit wuth Capacity inside this unit.
